Explained the architecture at a high level: one WalletBackend trait with NWC (Lightning) and Cashu (ecash) backends, Rust owning all policy and secret material, wallet state as Nostr events synced across devices, a durable operation journal for crash-safe spending, and fail-closed behavior for unknown mints or missing proofs.
can/should we use Trellis for the internal mechanics of the state machine of the wallet? -- get a second opinion on this question from a fable agent

Concluded (with Fable agreement) that Trellis should not be used for the wallet's durable money-safety journal, because Trellis graphs are in-memory and per-session by design while the journal's purpose is surviving process death after irreversible mint spends. Trellis can still serve the wallet's read projection invisibly; the write-side journal should use the standard NMP actor pattern with a persisted journal.
